name: independent-pre-upgrade-recovery
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: The pre-upgrade backup runs on its own build with its own data
steps.actual: The pre-upgrade dump and file archive were restored into an empty fourth project running the earlier image openlaw-local:d1d098ba9f4b, the build that wrote them. /readyz answered 200, the Administrator and the Contributor signed in, all 3 Contracts are present, 4 Document Versions downloaded with matching SHA-256 values, and the Contributor still reads Contract 1 while the Confidential Contract answers 404. Work accepted after the backup is absent (0 post-backup Contracts here), which is what the guide says a backup cannot recover. No older image was pointed at the migrated database.
